title: Trailforge Studios - Grey GUI
description: A sleek Vanilla+ resource pack that gives Minecraft’s GUI a clean, consistent grey redesign.
body:
# Trailforge Studios - Grey GUI

Give Minecraft’s menus a cleaner and more consistent look.

**Trailforge Studios – Grey GUI** is a resource pack that redesigns the game’s interface with a simple grey color palette. It keeps the familiar Minecraft style while making inventories, menus, containers, and other screens feel more polished and easier on the eyes.

The pack is made to blend naturally with the game, so the GUI feels refreshed without looking out of place.

### Features
- Clean grey interface redesign
- Updated menus, inventories, and containers
- Consistent look across the game
- Works well with other Vanilla-style resource packs

A simple visual upgrade for players who want a calmer and more refined Minecraft interface.
